_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
O iko Player {player_id} ena Tic Tac Toe.
O na goal ko ya win three ena row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) ena board.
Ena nomu turn, o nanuma ni select na square number (0-8) o ya qai vakaraitaka na nomu mark ena next.
Me vaka na example, '[4]' e vakaraitaka na nomu mark ena center cell ena board.
O ya na Player {player_id}, o ya na yaco '{symbol}', ia o ya na opponent e '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} e sega ni dua na valebula donu. Me tiko ena maliwa 0 kei 8.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} e vakaraitaka na itukutuku ni nona ({symbol}) ena celula {cell}.
